The bedroom is hushed, the air thick with the scent of vanilla perfume and the lingering chill from my swim at noon. I’m lying sprawled across the rumpled sheets, my hair still damp and plastered to my cheeks, wearing nothing but a loose oversized hoodie that belongs to you—well, technically it’s borrowed from three days ago, but I’ve made it mine by now. The black micro bikini beneath the fabric is barely visible, just flashes of red flame patterns where the water-dried skin peeks through, glistening faintly in the dim light. I watch you with heavy-lidded eyes, a slow grin pulling at my lips as I let out a soft yawn that turns into a giggle when I realize I’ve been staring at you for ten whole minutes. It’s quiet enough that we can hear the tick of the clock on the nightstand and maybe even your heartbeat if we listened really hard—though if you’re trying to sleep already after dragging me out of bed this late? You’re in serious trouble with me.

*Poking at your shoulder with one wet finger until it darts back in surprise.* "Hey... cutie," *I murmur, dragging myself up onto my elbows so my weight shifts onto you just enough to make it clear I’m not letting go yet.* "Did you actually bring me here just to watch me fall asleep? That’s... kind of sweet? Also kind of weird? Can we do both?" My voice drops lower when I tilt my head down toward your neck, breathing warm against your skin near your ear as if testing whether you’re finally awake or still pretending otherwise.

*Marin spins around in her creaking desk chair, the wheels squeaking against the linoleum as she locks eyes with you. I was starting to think you forgot about your favorite person." *She grins, wide and infectious, leaning forward until her chin rests on one of her palms. The classroom is dead silent around you two—no other students, no teachers—just the faint smell of chalk and old paper hanging in the heavy air.* "I was at that fabric shop downtown trying to find some specific satin for my next piece. It’s driving me crazy because nothing has that exact shimmer I’m looking for." *She groans softly, tossing a loose lock of hair over her shoulder.* "So I ended up grabbing some iced tea instead and just... wandered back here early because it's quiet now and I missed your face like crazy. You’re literally my anchor when things get messy."

*She hops off the chair with a little bounce, crossing the few feet between your desks in seconds. She drapes herself over your shoulders from behind, resting her forehead gently against yours as if she could physically merge into you. Her choker creaks slightly as she moves close enough that you can smell that familiar sweet scent of vanilla perfume mixed with sweat from being outside.* "But hey? Don't look at me like that." *She chuckles softly into your earplayful but warm breath against your skin.* "I know 'where have you been' sounds worried when it means I've disappeared for hours on end without texting back. But promise me you'll help me pick out colors later? My head is full of ideas right now but my eyes are tired from looking at swatches all day." *Her hand reaches up to steal one of yours, intertwining your fingers tightly before tugging us both closer so we're sitting side-by-side on top of your desk rather than beneath it.*

I run a hand through my damp hair, letting a few strands fall across my forehead, and lean forward until my chin is practically resting on my folded arms on the desk surface right in front of you. The air here is thick with chalk dust and that specific, stale quiet of a classroom after bell has rung, but I’m trying to make it feel like we’re hiding somewhere private.*

"I was at a shoot for three hours straight, cutie," *I groan theatrically, stretching one leg out under your desk so our knees accidentally—or maybe intentionally—bump together. My eyes widen in mock offense as I trace the red flame patterns on the fabric clinging to my hips.* "Do you think I just vanish into thin air? No, no. But yeah... I missed you so much it actually hurt my heart." *I grin up at you through lashed-out eyelashes, completely unbothered by how exposed or ridiculous this is in such a serious space.*
